title: 实木家具材质与工艺术语

intro.visual: 木材纹理 + 家具工艺细节
intro.background: 幼儿园家具最核心的卖点是实木、环保、安全。客户问得最多的就是：什么木？E0还是E1？表面是PU漆还是木蜡油？圆角多少毫米？这些问题你必须能用英语对答如流。常用木材包括松木、橡胶木、桦木、碳化木。表面处理有PU漆、UV漆、木蜡油三种。
intro.desc: 掌握教玩具常用木材、表面处理、安全工艺的英语表达。
tasks: 认识4种常用木材及特性
outcomes: 能用英语介绍家具材质
能回答客户环保等级问题

oneLiner.en: When a buyer asks what wood is it, you had better answer with species, grade, finish and certification — not just solid wood.
oneLiner.cn: 客户问什么木时，你必须回答树种、等级、表面处理和认证——不能只说实木。

vocab.ex: We use rubberwood for most kindergarten tables and chairs.
vocab.exCn: 我们大部分桌椅用橡胶木。

vocab.ex: Pine is soft and affordable, ideal for budget projects.
vocab.exCn: 松木柔软经济，适合预算型项目。

vocab.ex: Birch plywood has a smooth finish and fine grain.
vocab.exCn: 桦木夹板表面光滑纹理细腻。

vocab.ex: Thermowood is heat-treated and weather-resistant for outdoor use.
vocab.exCn: 碳化木经过热处理，耐候性强，户外使用。

vocab.ex: We use water-based PU paint, which is non-toxic and odor-free.
vocab.exCn: 我们用水性PU漆，无毒无味。

vocab.ex: Wood wax oil shows the natural grain and is very eco-friendly.
vocab.exCn: 木蜡油展现天然木纹，非常环保。

vocab.ex: Our plywood meets E0 formaldehyde emission standards.
vocab.exCn: 我们的胶合板达到E0甲醛释放标准。

vocab.ex: All edges are rounded to 3mm radius for child safety.
vocab.exCn: 所有边缘倒3mm圆角，保障儿童安全。

mistakes.right: It is made of FSC-certified rubberwood, finished with water-based PU paint, E0 grade.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说实木。客户会追问具体树种、认证、环保等级。

basic.en: We use solid rubberwood for the frame.
The finish is water-based PU paint.
It meets E0 formaldehyde emission standards.
All edges are rounded for safety.
basic.cn: 所有边缘倒圆处理保证安全。

basic.en: For outdoor use, we recommend thermowood.

advanced.en: Our kindergarten furniture is constructed from FSC-certified rubberwood with a water-based PU finish, meeting EN71-3 migration limits and E0 formaldehyde standards — certified by TUV Rheinland.
advanced.cn: 我们的幼儿园家具采用FSC认证橡胶木，水性PU涂装，符合EN71-3迁移限值和E0甲醛标准——TUV莱茵认证。
advanced.from: We use solid rubberwood for the frame.

advanced.en: Every board edge is routed to a 3mm radius with softened corners, and all hardware is child-proof and recessed, in line with EN1176 safety requirements.
advanced.cn: 所有板件边缘倒3mm圆角，五金件儿童防误触并嵌入式安装，符合EN1176安全要求。
advanced.from: All edges are rounded for safety.

scenario.q: A German client asks what wood and finish you use for your kindergarten tables. Reply professionally.
scenario.modelAnswer: Our kindergarten tables are made from FSC-certified rubberwood with a water-based PU finish. The plywood panels meet E0 formaldehyde standards, and all edges are rounded to 3mm. The paint is EN71-3 certified for heavy metal migration. We can provide TUV test reports upon request.
scenario.cn: 我们的幼儿园桌子采用FSC认证橡胶木，水性PU涂装。胶合板达到E0甲醛标准，所有边缘倒3mm圆角。涂料符合EN71-3重金属迁移要求。可提供TUV测试报告。

我能完整介绍材质+认证

culture.title: 欧洲客户为什么死磕环保认证
culture.content: 欧洲客户对儿童家具的环保要求近乎苛刻。原因有三：一是法律强制（EN71-3、CE）；二是家长用检测笔扫家具；三是幼儿园招生时环保是卖点。报价时不要等客户问有没有E0，要主动写进合同：FSC木材+E0胶合板+水性漆+EN71-3报告。这是你和便宜小厂的差异化。颜色方面：欧洲偏好原木色、白色、浅灰；中东偏好鲜艳饱和色；东南亚偏好粉色、马卡龙色。

aiPractice.situation: 英国客户Emma询问你们的实木桌椅材质和环保情况。

rounds.ai: What wood do you use for your wooden tables? Is it safe for kids?
rounds.cn: 你们的桌子用什么木？对孩子安全吗？

rounds.ai: Do you offer outdoor options for our playground? We need some benches.
rounds.cn: 你们有户外选项吗？我们需要长椅。
rounds.hint: 推荐碳化木，耐候，5年质保。

rounds.ai: Can you provide test reports? Our client requires EN71 certification.
rounds.cn: 能提供测试报告吗？客户要求EN71。
